items.question: What does scripture declare about the path to devotion?
premises: devotion is only in the guru
items.inference: The guru is the sole path to devotion.
uncertainties: gurau is rendered as in-teacher rather than a broader locative sense
context beyond the supplied adjacent verses is not used
items.plain_english: Devotion is only in the guru, O goddess; there is no other path—thus says scripture.
